observed_behavior: Static source: the load tag invokes main:setup/load. That function calls environmental/load_day_cycle_extender, setup/scoreboard, and setup/gamerules, sends two load messages, and reports difficulty. setup/scoreboard creates version_number with current_version set to 112. setup/revoke_all_recipe_unlock_advancements revokes many recipe_unlocks advancements. tutorial/root starts from minecraft:tick and tutorial/obtain_kiln follows obtain_dry_grass.
inferred_purpose: Inference: The source appears intended to turn first play and version updates into a guided, staged path while surfacing instructions in advancements. Confidence: medium.
rationale: The reset and global gamerule changes are deliberate compatibility overrides, while the instructional advancement tree can be retained only after vanilla-control and new-player tests.
required_tests: Fresh Matcha player from spawn through first milestone; vanilla-control world; recipe reset on first join and update; Matcha absent and unsupported-version startup; two-player join ordering.
notes: Evidence: generated/matcha/1.12/functions.json, scoreboards.json, advancements.json, and vanilla-overrides.csv. No runtime trace was supplied, so the exact first milestone and selector scope remain unverified.

observed_behavior: Static source: campfire.json creates an unlit campfire from logs and sticks. fire_starter.json uses two flint for flint_and_steel. light_campfire watches item_used_on_block with campfire and flint_and_steel. beacon_kindling_placed changes a marker location to a signal_fire campfire and starts the trader timer; the timer checks whether that campfire is lit.
inferred_purpose: Inference: Ordinary fire and campfire use appear to remain available while a campfire can also act as a deliberate beacon trigger. Confidence: medium.
rationale: Keep normal ignition and cooking available, but isolate and explicitly order the beacon/trader override because it changes a campfire into a world event.
required_tests: Fire, soul fire, campfire cooking, rain, water, extinguishing, and multiplayer beacon tests; vanilla control; absent resource pack; unsupported Matcha profile.
notes: Evidence: generated/matcha/1.12/recipes.json, functions.json, advancements.json, and pack-filters.json. The archive has no runtime trace for ignition, spread, or trader arrival.

observed_behavior: Static source: mudkiln.json crafts a smoker from mud bricks, packed mud, and a campfire. oven.json crafts a furnace from bricks, iron, and a campfire. The audit inventory contains 26 blasting, 30 smoking, and 3 smelting recipes, while food supplies additional smelting and campfire recipes. No custom kiln block file was observed.
inferred_purpose: Inference: The recipes appear intended to make processing stations and alternate cooking routes part of the early material path without replacing the vanilla processing engine. Confidence: medium.
rationale: Extend the vanilla stations and preserve automation unless a traced recipe conflict requires a narrow override.
required_tests: Furnace, blast furnace, smoker, campfire, automation, fuel, XP, interruption, and recipe-unlock vanilla controls; absent and unsupported Matcha cases.
notes: Evidence: generated/matcha/1.12/recipes.json and advancements.json. Runtime timing, container behaviour, and exact recipe conflicts were not observed.

observed_behavior: Static source: copper_pickaxe produces a minecraft:copper_pickaxe with tool rules, max_damage 350, and an item_model. bronze_pickaxe transforms a copper pickaxe and returns a stone_pickaxe with max_damage 1000 plus mining and attribute components. adamant_mattock returns a netherite_hoe with max_damage 5000 and tool rules. Resource item definitions and models are placed in the minecraft namespace.
inferred_purpose: Inference: The tier and tool files appear intended to create a material ladder and additional tool roles by reusing vanilla base items. Confidence: medium.
rationale: The same vanilla IDs are assigned different tool rules, attributes, and models. Keep this behind the profile-scoped identity adapter until unknown signatures and durability are tested.

The abbey map trade sets item_model abbey_map on map output.

inferred_purpose: Inference: The source appears intended to replace passive regeneration with a stricter hunger pressure model. Confidence: medium.

Estus processing checks blaze_powder and gives difficulty-dependent regeneration and resistance, gives glowstone dust, and clears blaze powder. cake_eaten grants instant_health and health_boost. A heart container adds Hearts and regeneration before clearing one matching item. A warding stone gives regeneration to tagged friendly entities.

observed_behavior: Static source: inventory_changed rewards reset_breakable_repair_cost. That function checks inventory slots and hotbar slots for minecraft:repair_cost, sets each observed repair_cost to zero, and revokes its advancement. Tool recipes assign max_damage and repairable components. No Matcha function intercepts an item reaching zero damage.
inferred_purpose: Inference: The namespace appears intended to remove the increasing anvil repair-cost barrier, but the archive does not establish a retained broken-item transition. Confidence: high for the observed commands, medium for purpose.

required_tests: Damage at one and zero, repair through every route, enchantment interaction, container/trade movement, item preservation, FVR-101 regression, vanilla item control, Matcha absent, and unsupported profile.
notes: Evidence: generated/matcha/1.12/functions.json and advancements.json. Flag for FVR-101 owner: preserve the original item on failed mapping and never assume repair_cost reset equals endless durability.

notes: Evidence: generated/matcha/1.12/functions.json and scoreboards.json. Exact stopwatch semantics and selector scope need a disposable-server trace.
